title: euphrasia pectinata subsp. simplex
intro: Euphrasia pectinata subsp. simplex, commonly known as the "Eyebright" plant, is a species of flowering plant in the family Orobanchaceae. It is used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to treat eye infections, coughs, and respiratory issues, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Eyebright include its ability to reduce inflammation, kill bacteria, and soothe irritated tissues, making it a popular natural remedy for colds, sinusitis, and conjunctivitis. The bioactive constituents of Eyebright include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects on human health.
